descriptionEn: Boiled whole, pulled by hand, dipped in garlic and vinegar. Nomadic and primal.
descriptionZh: 整块水煮，徒手撕扯，蘸蒜醋而食。游牧本味。

ingrEn: For dipping: minced garlic, black vinegar, chili oil, fresh coriander
ingrZh: 蘸料：蒜末、黑醋、辣椒油、香菜
stepsEn: Place lamb in a pot of cold water. Bring to a boil, cook 5 min, then discard the water. Rinse the lamb and the pot.
Return lamb to the clean pot. Add onion, ginger, star anise, Sichuan peppercorns, Shaoxing wine and enough cold water to cover by 5cm.
Bring to a boil, skim any foam, then reduce to a steady simmer. Cook 1.5–2 hours until the meat pulls easily from the bone.
Remove lamb and let rest 10 min. Pull the meat with your hands into large chunks — this is deliberate, not lazy. Bones come out naturally.
Serve immediately with dipping sauce. The broth is for drinking alongside.
stepsZh: 羊肉冷水下锅，煮沸5分钟后倒掉水，冲洗羊肉和锅。
羊肉放回清锅，加洋葱、姜片、八角、花椒、绍兴酒和足量冷水，超过羊肉5厘米。
大火烧开，撇净浮沫，转中小火保持稳定沸腾，煮1.5-2小时至肉可轻松离骨。
取出羊肉，静置10分钟，用手将肉撕成大块——这是刻意为之，不是懒惰，骨头自然脱出。
立即上桌，配蘸料食用，汤可以随餐喝。
details.notesEn: The point of hand-pulling is texture — the meat tears along its natural grain, which no knife can replicate. The broth, strained and salted, is one of the finest things you can drink.
details.notesZh: 徒手撕肉的意义在于质感——肉沿自然纹理撕裂，这是刀切无法复制的。将汤过滤后加盐，是你能喝到的最好的东西之一。
